variations.name: Lithium-ion grid BESS (LFP/NMC) & system integrators
variations.description: Containerized lithium iron phosphate (and some NMC) battery plants — cells integrated with inverters, thermal management, and control software — are the workhorse of grid storage, shifting solar and wind output and beating gas peakers on cost in many markets (~460 GWh shipped globally in 2025).

companies.name: Tesla
companies.what: Megapack utility-scale BESS built in dedicated Megafactories (Lathrop, Shanghai; Megapack 3 from Houston in 2026)
companies.signal: 46.7 GWh deployed in 2025, up 49% YoY; #2 global BESS supplier

companies.name: BYD
companies.what: Vertically integrated LFP cell-to-container systems (MC Cube); overtook Tesla as the #1 BESS supplier in 2025
companies.signal: #1 global BESS systems supplier 2025; top-3 with Tesla/Sungrow hold ~1/3 of market

companies.name: Sungrow
companies.what: Inverter giant selling liquid-cooled PowerTitan AC-coupled BESS worldwide
companies.signal: #3 global BESS supplier 2025; narrowed gap to Tesla per Wood Mackenzie

companies.name: Fluence Energy
companies.what: Siemens-AES joint venture; Gridstack platform with domestic-content US manufacturing strategy
companies.signal: NASDAQ: FLNC; one of only two non-Chinese top-10 integrators; expanded Ohio facility Sept 2025

companies.name: CATL
companies.what: World's largest battery cell maker; TENER 6.25 MWh 'zero-degradation' storage container
companies.signal: ~20% of global ESS cell market in 2025, the top cell supplier

companies.name: HiTHIUM
companies.what: ESS-only LFP cell and system maker (large-format 1,175 Ah cells) focused purely on stationary storage
companies.signal: Top-tier global ESS cell shipments alongside CATL/EVE

companies.name: FlexGen
companies.what: US integrator whose HybridOS EMS runs multi-vendor BESS fleets; consolidator of distressed rivals
companies.signal: Acquired bankrupt Powin's assets for $36M, closed Aug 2025

companies.name: LG Energy Solution (Vertech)
companies.what: Turnkey US grid BESS arm pairing LG cells (incl. US-made) with integration and long-term service
companies.signal: Multi-GWh US project pipeline; integration partner on flagship projects incl. Element Energy's 53 MWh second-life site

companies.name: Powin
companies.what: Was the 3rd-largest US BESS integrator (11.3 GWh installed incl. 1.9 GWh Waratah Super Battery) with a China-dependent supply chain
companies.signal: Filed Chapter 11 June 10, 2025, eight months after a $200M KKR facility; tariffs and ITC uncertainty cited; assets sold to FlexGen

companies.name: Northvolt
companies.what: European cell maker whose Gdansk 'Dwa' plant was Europe's largest BESS systems factory (6 GWh capable)
companies.signal: Bankrupt March 2025; BESS factory and Swedish gigafactories acquired by Lyten (Oct 2025 / Feb 2026)

variations.name: Sodium-ion & molten-sodium batteries
variations.description: Sodium replaces lithium as the working ion — either in lithium-ion-like ambient cells (sodium-ion) or in ~250-300C molten sodium-metal-halide cells — promising cheaper, fire-safer, lithium-free storage, though collapsed lithium prices have erased much of the near-term cost case.

companies.name: CATL
companies.what: Naxtra sodium-ion brand (launched April 2025) with a dedicated BESS sodium-ion cell; mass production from end-2025
companies.signal: Confirmed large-scale 2026 deployment; secured 'world's largest sodium-ion battery order' April 2026

companies.name: HiNa Battery
companies.what: Chinese Academy of Sciences spinout; the most prolific commercializer of sodium-ion BESS to date (cells in 100 MWh-class Chinese projects)
companies.signal: Cells used in China's first 100 MWh-scale sodium-ion BESS projects (2024-2025)

companies.name: BYD
companies.what: Building dedicated sodium-ion capacity; MWh-scale grid-connected sodium BESS demo passed acceptance in 2025
companies.signal: Sodium battery capacity reportedly heading toward tens of GWh; 2.3 MWh grid demo operating

companies.name: Peak Energy
companies.what: US sodium-ion (NFPP) systems with fully passive thermal design; first grid-scale sodium-ion BESS deployed in the US (Colorado pilot, Sept 2025)
companies.signal: $10M seed + $55M Series A; Nov 2025 deal with Jupiter Power for up to 4.75 GWh (>$500M), largest US sodium-ion deal

companies.name: Natron Energy
companies.what: Prussian-blue sodium-ion cells for data-center and industrial power; opened first US sodium-ion factory (Holland, MI) in 2024
companies.signal: Shut down Sept 2025 after funding fell through; $1.4B North Carolina gigafactory cancelled; 95 laid off

companies.name: Tiamat
companies.what: French high-power sodium-ion (polyanionic) cell developer planning a 5 GWh gigafactory near Amiens
companies.signal: Factory commissioning slipped to 2026-27; €150M round announced 2024 not yet finalized

companies.name: Faradion
companies.what: UK sodium-ion pioneer with broad early patents
companies.signal: Acquired by Reliance Industries (2022, ~£100M) to anchor Indian sodium-ion manufacturing

companies.name: Inlyte Energy
companies.what: Iron-sodium (sodium metal halide) cells built on the original Beta Research UK site, targeting 10-24h storage
companies.signal: $8M seed + $4.1M DOE (June 2025); factory acceptance test of world's largest Na-metal-chloride cells Dec 2025; US production targeted 2026-27

companies.name: FZSoNick
companies.what: Swiss/Italian maker of sodium-nickel-chloride (ZEBRA) batteries for telecom, rail, and niche stationary backup
companies.signal: Decades-long commercial niche production

variations.white_space: Western sodium-ion collapsed in 2025 (Natron shut down, Northvolt gone, Tiamat delayed) just as Chinese giants committed gigafactories — sodium's cost edge only appears at scale and when lithium is expensive. The opening is Western capacity anchored to niches lithium serves poorly (data-center UPS, cold climates, fire-code-constrained sites) or molten-sodium routes that sidestep li-ion's cost curve.

variations.name: Iron-air & other metal-air
variations.description: Cells charge by 'unrusting' iron (or another metal) and discharge by re-oxidizing it with air, storing 100+ hours of energy at very low cost per kWh but only ~40-50% round-trip efficiency — built for multi-day wind/solar droughts rather than daily cycling.

companies.name: Form Energy
companies.what: 100-hour iron-air systems manufactured at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV; the category-defining player
companies.signal: $405M Series F (Oct 2024, T. Rowe Price + GE Vernova), >$1.2B raised; first project (1.5 MW/150 MWh with Great River Energy, Cambridge MN) online ~late 2025, more in MN/CO/CA/NY/GA/VA through 2026

companies.name: Ore Energy
companies.what: TU Delft spinout that connected the world's first grid-connected, operational iron-air battery (Delft, NL, operating since May 2025)
companies.signal: ~€10M seed (2024) plus grants, ~€20M total; piloting 100-hour BESS with EDF lab in France; 4.2 MWh containers planned

companies.name: Phinergy
companies.what: Israeli aluminum-air (primary, non-rechargeable) systems for telecom and backup power
companies.signal: Tel Aviv-listed; commercial backup deployments with telecom operators

variations.white_space: Effectively a one-company category: Form's $1.2B war chest dwarfs everyone, and physics (low round-trip efficiency and power density) confines metal-air to multi-day markets that today's tariffs and capacity products barely remunerate, deterring followers. Openings: non-US iron-air champions (Ore in the EU), and market-design/revenue-stack work that creates paid multi-day reliability products.

variations.name: Flow batteries (vanadium, iron, zinc-bromine, organic)
variations.description: Energy is stored in liquid electrolytes pumped through a reactor stack, decoupling power from energy so duration stretches cheaply to 4-12+ hours with 20,000+ cycles and no fire risk; vanadium leads (scaling fast in China), while iron, zinc-bromine, and organic chemistries chase cheaper electrolytes.

companies.name: Rongke Power
companies.what: World's largest vanadium flow battery maker (built the 100 MW/400 MWh Dalian plant)
companies.signal: Commissioned 100 MW/400 MWh Changzhou project Aug 2025 using electrolyte leasing (-35-40% capex); bid 300 MWh into ERCOT's first 6-hour products Jan 2026

companies.name: Sumitomo Electric
companies.what: VRFB pioneer (51 MWh Hokkaido system) selling utility-grade flow batteries for decades
companies.signal: Launched next-gen VRFB Feb 2025: +15% energy density, -30% cost, 30-year life

companies.name: Invinity Energy Systems
companies.what: LSE-listed modular vanadium flow systems (ENDURIUM) for utility, C&I, and microgrid projects
companies.signal: ~80+ MWh delivered across 80+ sites; 10.8 MWh Hungary solar-plus-storage order in 2025

companies.name: CellCube
companies.what: Austrian vanadium flow systems for C&I, microgrids, and mining off-grid sites
companies.signal: 130+ systems deployed worldwide

companies.name: ESS Tech (ESS Inc.)
companies.what: NYSE-listed iron-flow battery maker (Energy Warehouse/Energy Center/Energy Base) using earth-abundant iron electrolyte
companies.signal: Going-concern doubt; nearly closed Oregon plant May 2025, survived on emergency funding with mass furloughs; $0.8M unrestricted cash at Q2 2025

companies.name: Redflow
companies.what: Australian zinc-bromine flow battery maker (ZBM3) with US DOE/CEC project wins
companies.signal: Entered voluntary administration Aug 2024 after failing to raise scale-up capital; liquidated Dec 2024

companies.name: CMBlu Energy
companies.what: German 'Organic SolidFlow' batteries with lignin-derived electrolytes, pitched as a lithium alternative for hyperscalers
companies.signal: 5 MW/50 MWh Desert Blume pilot with Salt River Project (AZ) operational ~Dec 2025; national-lab demos in microgrids/cold climates

companies.name: Quino Energy
companies.what: Harvard spinout making water-based organic quinone electrolytes from dye-industry precursors at near-zero marginal plant cost
companies.signal: $10M+$6M Series A (Nov 2025, Atri); $10M California Energy Commission grant for an 8 MWh demo; $5M DOE manufacturing grant

companies.name: XL Batteries
companies.what: pH-neutral saltwater organic flow battery; first US flow-battery partnership aimed at data-center campuses
companies.signal: $28M raised (incl. $7.5M Sept 2025); pilots with Prometheus Hyperscale and Stolthaven Terminals (Houston)

companies.name: Stryten Energy
companies.what: US lead-battery manufacturer expanding into vanadium flow; Storion Energy JV (with Largo) for domestic vanadium electrolyte supply
companies.signal: JV formed 2024 to onshore VRFB electrolyte production

variations.name: Zinc-based non-flow batteries (zinc-bromine static, zinc-air, zinc-ion, nickel-zinc)
variations.description: Zinc anodes in static (non-pumped) cells — zinc-bromine gel, zinc-air, zinc-manganese alkaline, nickel-zinc — deliver non-flammable, lithium-free storage from abundant materials, trading lower efficiency and energy density for safety and indoor/urban siting flexibility.

companies.name: Eos Energy Enterprises
companies.what: Znyth zinc-bromine static cells manufactured in Pittsburgh on a US-only supply chain (Project AMAZE, 8 GWh by 2027)
companies.signal: NASDAQ: EOSE; $303.5M DOE loan closed Dec 2024, second draw July 2025; ~$589M backlog and $14B pipeline (late 2024)

companies.name: ZincFive
companies.what: Nickel-zinc UPS battery cabinets (BC 2 AI) for AI data centers — zero thermal-runaway backup power
companies.signal: $30M oversubscribed Series F (Dec 2025); $254M raised since 2016

companies.name: e-Zinc
companies.what: Toronto startup storing energy in physical zinc metal (zinc-air cell) for multi-day duration
companies.signal: ~$31M commercialization funding (2024); first field pilots in Ontario and California

companies.name: Salient Energy
companies.what: Water-based zinc-ion cells (zinc-manganese) for home/resi storage; first zinc-ion to pass UL9540A fire testing
companies.signal: UL9540A passed; claims +150% cell energy density progress; pre-commercial

companies.name: Urban Electric Power
companies.what: Rechargeable zinc-manganese alkaline batteries (Pearl River, NY) for fire-safe building and grid storage
companies.signal: ~$31M raised; NYSERDA long-duration storage demo award; DOE voucher

companies.name: Enzinc
companies.what: Zinc microsponge anode that drops into existing lead-acid factories to make nickel-zinc batteries
companies.signal: $1.62M California Energy Commission award (July 2025); US anode manufacturing center opened 2024

companies.name: Zinc8 Energy Solutions (ABOUND Energy)
companies.what: Zinc-air long-duration storage developer that planned a New York factory
companies.signal: Chronic funding distress and going-concern warnings since 2023; rebranded ABOUND Energy; little verifiable commercial activity since

companies.name: Gelion
companies.what: Australian battery developer that abandoned its zinc-bromine gel battery and pivoted to lithium-sulfur — itself evidence of zinc's scale-up difficulty
companies.signal: ASX-listed; zinc product discontinued in favor of Li-S IP (OXIS/Johnson Matthey acquisitions)

variations.white_space: Zinc's dendrite and efficiency problems have killed or bent several players (Redflow liquidated, Zinc8 distressed, Gelion pivoted away), but non-flammability is winning real niches indoors. The opening is anchoring to fire-code-driven demand — data-center UPS, urban and defense sites — rather than fighting LFP head-on per kWh, as ZincFive's data-center traction and Eos's DOE-backed onshore story show.

variations.name: High-temperature liquid-metal & sodium-sulfur
variations.description: Cells operate at 250-700C with molten electrodes or ceramic electrolytes (sodium-sulfur, calcium-antimony liquid metal), offering long calendar life and cheap materials for 6-12 hour storage — but the only mass producer is now exiting after losing the economics race to LFP.

companies.name: NGK Insulators
companies.what: Sole mass producer of sodium-sulfur (NAS) grid batteries for 20+ years (~5 GWh deployed; 70 MWh Japan project and Duke Energy pilot in May 2025)
companies.signal: Announced discontinuation of NAS manufacturing and new orders Oct 31, 2025 after expansion talks with BASF ended

companies.name: BASF Stationary Energy Storage
companies.what: Global sales/development partner for NAS since 2019; co-developed NAS MODEL L24 with <1%/year degradation (June 2024)
companies.signal: Partnership discussions with NGK discontinued Sept 2025; unit's future unclear

companies.name: Ambri
companies.what: Calcium-antimony liquid-metal cells (Sadoway/MIT) with no degradation mechanism, now targeting data centers
companies.signal: Chapter 11 May 2024; emerged Aug 2024 under lender consortium (Gates Frontier, Paulson); first containerized systems shipping, ~$35M revenue reported 2025

variations.white_space: The non-lithium chemistry with the longest real grid track record (NAS, ~5 GWh over two decades) is being abandoned by its only manufacturer, and the flagship liquid-metal startup went bankrupt — high operating temperature plus bespoke manufacturing simply lost to LFP's cost curve. Openings: acquiring/licensing NGK's proven NAS IP and servicing its installed fleet, or intermediate-temperature sodium-halide designs (e.g., Inlyte) that reuse the supply chain at lower temperature and cost.

variations.name: Nickel-hydrogen & novel aqueous chemistries (lead-carbon, aluminum-ion)
variations.description: Space-proven nickel-hydrogen pressure vessels and water-based chemistries (aqueous sodium/manganese oxide, lead-carbon, aluminum-ion) promise 20,000-30,000 cycles, wide temperature tolerance, and zero fire risk, betting that lifetime and safety can beat lithium's upfront cost.

companies.name: EnerVenue
companies.what: Nickel-hydrogen 'Energy Storage Vessels' rated for 30,000 cycles and -40 to +60C operation
companies.signal: ~$500M+ raised incl. $300M Series B extension (April 2026); Kentucky gigafactory built, first high-volume line now in Changzhou, China (250 MWh by Q3 2026); Gen-4 pilots on five continents

companies.name: Alsym Energy
companies.what: Non-flammable, non-toxic aqueous metal-oxide chemistry; launched Na-Series sodium-based stationary line Oct 2025
companies.signal: ~$78M raised (General Catalyst, Tata); product launch but no large deployments yet

companies.name: Narada Power
companies.what: Chinese battery maker deploying lead-carbon ESS at industrial-park scale (alongside its Li-ion lines)
companies.signal: Hundreds of MWh of lead-carbon storage operating in China

companies.name: Graphene Manufacturing Group (GMG)
companies.what: Australian developer of graphene-aluminum-ion cells claiming fast charge and high cycle life
companies.signal: ASX-listed; coin/pouch-cell stage, no grid deployments

companies.name: Aquion Energy
companies.what: Saltwater sodium-ion pioneer (aqueous hybrid ion) — the cautionary precedent for aqueous grid batteries
companies.signal: Raised ~$190M (incl. Gates), went bankrupt 2017; assets sold to Chinese buyers

variations.white_space: EnerVenue is nearly alone at scale: pressure-vessel capex and low volumetric energy density deter entrants, and Aquion's 2017 collapse still shadows aqueous chemistries. The opening is ultra-long-life niches where 30k cycles, wide temperature range, and zero fire suppression beat LFP on total cost — AI data centers, desert and off-grid sites — plus licensing models that avoid building gigafactories alone.

variations.name: Solid-state & advanced lithium for stationary use
variations.description: Solid or semi-solid electrolytes and advanced electrodes (lithium-sulfur, lithium-titanate/niobium anodes) aim to bring fire safety, very long cycle life, or cheaper electrode manufacturing to stationary lithium storage — though most solid-state developers chase EVs first and the grid gets their tech second.

companies.name: Lyten
companies.what: Lithium-sulfur developer that bought Northvolt's 6 GWh Gdansk BESS plant and Swedish gigafactories to ship BESS now and lithium-sulfur at gigascale later
companies.signal: Northvolt Dwa acquisition closed Oct 2025; Swedish Ett/Labs acquisition completed Feb 2026

companies.name: 24M Technologies
companies.what: Licenses SemiSolid thick-electrode manufacturing (~40% lower material cost, shorter production time) to cell makers
companies.signal: Licensees include Kyocera; Kyocera doubled SemiSolid production Dec 2024

companies.name: Kyocera
companies.what: Enerezza residential ESS — the world's first SemiSolid-electrode battery product line (5-15 kWh)
companies.signal: 20,000 units/yr capacity, doubling with a JPY 10B investment by FY2026

companies.name: Toshiba
companies.what: SCiB lithium-titanate (LTO) cells with 20,000+ cycles used in high-power frequency-regulation and grid BESS
companies.signal: Decades of commercial LTO production; deployed in Japanese grid frequency projects

companies.name: Echion Technologies
companies.what: XNO niobium-oxide anode enabling fast-charge, 10,000+ cycle cells for industrial and grid-adjacent high-power duty
companies.signal: £29M Series B (2024); anode in commercial cell partners' lines

companies.name: LiNa Energy
companies.what: UK solid-state sodium-metal-chloride planar cells purpose-built for low-cost stationary storage
companies.signal: Seed/grant-funded; kW-scale field pilots

companies.name: Ion Storage Systems
companies.what: Ceramic anodeless solid-state cells (UMD spinout) with defense and stationary-adjacent first markets
companies.signal: $30M+ raised; pilot production line in Maryland

variations.white_space: Solid-state's headline advantage — energy density — is nearly worthless for stationary storage, so no major solid-state player targets the grid first and the segment is thin. The opening is chemistry chosen FOR stationary economics: semi-solid electrode cost cuts, LTO/niobium cycle life for high-throughput grid services, and fire-code-friendly cells that unlock indoor, urban, and data-center siting.

variations.name: Supercapacitors & hybrid ion capacitors
variations.description: Electrostatic storage in high-surface-area carbon delivers millions of cycles and sub-second response but tiny energy capacity, suiting grid-forming inertia, power smoothing, and AI data-center peak shaving (usually hybridized with batteries) rather than energy shifting.

companies.name: Skeleton Technologies
companies.what: Curved-graphene supercapacitors and SuperBattery hybrid cells for grid stabilization and AI data-center power smoothing
companies.signal: Opened €220M Leipzig 'SuperFactory' Nov 2025 (12M cells/yr) shipping to Siemens, GE, Hitachi Energy and US hyperscalers; €392M raised; US IPO targeted 2027

companies.name: Eaton
companies.what: Supercapacitor modules integrated into UPS and grid power-quality equipment
companies.signal: Established global power-management product lines

companies.name: Nippon Chemi-Con
companies.what: Major Japanese capacitor maker producing DLCAP electric double-layer capacitors
companies.signal: Long-running commercial supercap product lines

companies.name: UCAP Power
companies.what: Acquired Maxwell Technologies' ultracapacitor business from Tesla (2021); grid, transport, and backup modules
companies.signal: Operating the largest US ultracap product portfolio

companies.name: LICAP Technologies
companies.what: Dry-electrode supercapacitor cells and modules (Sacramento) with licensing of its Activated Dry Electrode process
companies.signal: Commercial cell/module sales plus equipment licensing

companies.name: Shanghai Aowei
companies.what: Chinese supercapacitor systems powering supercap buses/trams and grid power-quality installations
companies.signal: Fleet-scale supercap transit deployments in China

variations.white_space: Physics caps energy density at roughly 1/20th of Li-ion, so supercaps cannot compete on $/kWh and most grid-storage supercap ventures died or retreated to components. The opening is the AI data-center power-quality boom and grid-forming inertia/fast-frequency markets — selling power equipment hybridized with batteries, the wedge Skeleton's hyperscaler pivot validates.

variations.name: Second-life EV battery storage
variations.description: Retired EV packs with 70-80% remaining capacity are tested, re-certified, and re-assembled into stationary systems, cutting upfront cell cost and deferring recycling — provided testing/repackaging costs and falling new-cell prices don't erase the discount.

companies.name: B2U Storage Solutions
companies.what: Plug-and-play architecture that uses EV packs whole (no repackaging) in merchant California/Texas storage plants
companies.signal: 25+ MWh operating; launched a structured fund holding 7 BESS projects (CA + TX, 2025)

companies.name: Element Energy
companies.what: Adaptive cell-level BMS that manages heterogeneous used packs; built the world's largest second-life BESS (53 MWh, West Texas)
companies.signal: 53 MWh commissioned Nov 2024 from 900 used EV packs; $111M equity+debt raised; partnership with LG ES Vertech

companies.name: Connected Energy
companies.what: UK containerized E-STOR systems built from Renault and JLR packs for C&I sites
companies.signal: Backed by Volvo Energy, Caterpillar Venture Capital, Mercuria; dozens of systems across Europe

companies.name: Moment Energy
companies.what: UL1974-certified EV pack repurposing with OEM supply agreements (Mercedes-Benz Energy)
companies.signal: $40M+ Series B (2025; >$100M total incl. $20.3M DOE award) to build a 1 GWh/yr second-life factory in Taylor, TX

companies.name: Voltfang
companies.what: German C&I and grid storage systems from certified second-life EV batteries
companies.signal: €15M Series B (June 2025); opened 'Europe's largest second-life battery factory' (Aachen, 250 MWh/yr target)

companies.name: Smartville
companies.what: MOAB second-life BESS platform that homogenizes mixed-OEM packs into utility-grade storage
companies.signal: DOE-backed; California deployments

companies.name: Mercedes-Benz Energy
companies.what: OEM arm operating utility-scale second-life plants since 2016 (13 MWh Lünen) and supplying used packs to partners like Moment
companies.signal: Long-running second-life supply agreements with repurposers

companies.name: Nissan / 4R Energy
companies.what: JV with Sumitomo refabricating Nissan Leaf packs for stationary use since 2010 (Namie plant, Japan)
companies.signal: Oldest operating second-life battery business

variations.white_space: Falling new LFP cell prices (now well under $60/kWh) keep compressing the used-pack discount, and heterogeneous, unpredictable pack supply makes industrial scaling hard — which is why the segment's largest single site is still only 53 MWh. The opening is OEM-locked feedstock contracts plus automated grading/repackaging (the Moment-Mercedes model), and markets that pay premiums for tariff-free, domestically sourced capacity.

variations.name: Behind-the-meter residential & C&I battery systems
variations.description: Home and small-commercial lithium (mostly LFP) batteries paired with rooftop solar and aggregated into virtual power plants give households backup power and give grids dispatchable distributed flexibility — now a mass consumer market in the US, Europe, Australia, and Japan.

companies.name: Tesla
companies.what: Powerwall 3 home battery plus the largest US virtual power plant fleets
companies.signal: Millions of Powerwalls shipped; utility VPP programs across CA/TX/PR

companies.name: Enphase Energy
companies.what: IQ Battery 5P integrated with its microinverter and home-energy ecosystem
companies.signal: NASDAQ-listed; among top US home battery brands

companies.name: Sigenergy
companies.what: SigenStor five-in-one AI-enabled stackable home/C&I battery-inverter-EV-charger system
companies.signal: Listed on HKEX; ranked #1 battery brand in Australia by capacity (March 2025)

companies.name: sonnen
companies.what: German sonnenBatterie pioneer of residential VPPs across Europe, Australia, and the US
companies.signal: Acquired by Shell in 2019 (~€500M); Shell has been seeking a buyer, reported valuation €1.35-1.8B

companies.name: FranklinWH
companies.what: aPower whole-home backup battery and energy-management system with US manufacturing
companies.signal: 4th most-used battery brand in US solar; California factory producing since April 2025, scaling 30k to 120k units/yr

companies.name: Base Power
companies.what: Utility-partnered home battery service bundling hardware with retail electricity, monetizing fleets in ERCOT and beyond
companies.signal: $1B Series C (Oct 2025, led by Addition) at ~$4B valuation; in-house Gen-3 battery manufacturing

companies.name: BYD
companies.what: Battery-Box residential LFP line — among the top-selling home batteries in Europe and Australia
companies.signal: Top-3 home battery brand in multiple European markets

companies.name: Sunrun
companies.what: Largest US residential solar+storage installer, dispatching its networked battery fleet as VPPs (e.g., CalReady)
companies.signal: NASDAQ-listed; gigawatt-hour-scale networked residential storage fleet
